response.overview: A prince is sent to a reclusive witch, seeking a cure for his dying younger brother, only to discover a curse in their bloodline requires the death of one royal life. The witch reveals his father has sent him be sacrificed in exchange for his brother—thus faced with betrayal, the prince must choose between familial love, loyalty, and the reclamation of his fate. Returning home, he finds kingdom in mourning; not for his brother, but for the king.
response.tagline: It is a vile thing that plagues your brother; i can smell it's stench on you as well.
response.title: Bloodbound
